conventions.evaluation: jinyiquant.evaluation local-v1, quantile 0.2, min_cross_section 3, periods_per_year 252, constant portfolios undefined
conventions.label_use: every version is scored against the same raw official vwap_return target values; model scores are used exactly as the saved weights predict them (score = network output * raw-label training std); no label inverse transform is applied to any version, and the centered/CSZ arms are not re-centred at evaluation time
conventions.long_short_return: equal-weight top/bottom 20% gross forward return spread; no fees, execution, overlap or compounding
conventions.official_score: not implemented; official platform preprocessing unavailable
conventions.rank_ic: Pearson correlation of average ranks within one prediction timestamp, equally averaged over that day's timestamps
conventions.rank_ic_ir: daily mean / sample std (ddof=1), not annualized

style_residualization.exposure_snapshot: most recent exposure date strictly before the signal date; all eight timestamps of a day use that same snapshot; same-day rows never used; no forward fill; stocks without a previous-day exposure row are dropped from that timestamp for every version
style_residualization.raw_reference: the raw-score metrics are also recomputed on the same exposure-common sample (raw_common) so the processed-vs-raw contrast is sample-identical
style_residualization.regression: equal-weight OLS without intercept on the 10 style factors + all 32 industry dummies; ret/weights/float_market_cap/industry_level1_code excluded
style_residualization.winsorize: per timestamp clip at median +/- 3 * 1.4826 * MAD; MAD==0 falls back to population std; constant section becomes zeros

conventions.turnover: 0.5*sum(abs(net_weight_t-net_weight_previous)) between consecutive sampled timestamps including overnight; first section undefined
conventions.worst_day: minimum daily long_short_return over the reported period

guardrails.long_short: material degradation only if the pooled mean paired daily long_short_return delta < 0 AND the block-5 95% interval upper bound < 0
guardrails.turnover: material degradation if candidate turnover_mean is more than 10% above the CSZ turnover_mean on the pooled development months (relative increase > 0.10)
guardrails.worst_day: material degradation if the candidate's worst single-day long_short_return over the pooled development months is more than 25% worse than CSZ's, i.e. (candidate_worst - csz_worst) / abs(csz_worst) < -0.25

framework.primary_metric: rank_ic_mean computed on the raw official labels (score used as predicted, no inverse transform)
framework.primary_sample: the three development months pooled (nov2023 + jan2024 + mar2024 = 65 trading days); july2023 is context only and is not used for the decision
framework.primary_test: paired daily rank_ic difference (candidate minus v2_60d_csz) over the pooled development months; contiguous-day moving-block bootstrap with block_days 5 and 2, 20000 draws, seed 20261024, 95% intervals
framework.rank_ic_improvement: mean paired rank_ic delta > 0 AND lower bound of the block-5 95% interval > 0 AND lower bound of the block-2 95% interval > 0 AND the per-month mean delta is positive in at least 2 of the 3 development months
framework.seed29_followup: triggered for a candidate whose verdict is better_than_csz, or whose pooled mean rank_ic delta is > 0 with no material guardrail degradation and block-5 lower bound > -0.005 (promising but not conclusive because only seed 11 exists); not triggered when the point estimate is not positive or a guardrail is materially degraded
framework.single_seed_note: seed 11 is the only seed for RAW/CENTER in this round; the decision framework therefore treats a single-seed win as a replication trigger, not as final promotion evidence
framework.style_view: the style-residualized view is reported as a robustness check only and does not override the pre-registered primary metric; a materially different conclusion under residualization is recorded as a disagreement, not used to re-select a winner

provenance.note: Append-only revision: every revision-1 top-level block keeps the same value digest; only this 'final_consolidation' block and the revision metadata are added.

recommendation.followup_hint: If the CENTER-to-CSZ gap is worth chasing, test the CSZ-specific variance/RMS matching as a single-factor experiment rather than adding seeds to a candidate that already lost; the July context window shows centering alone removes most of the RAW gap.
recommendation.question: submit RAW, CENTER, or keep CSZ and spend the slot on other improvements
rationale: RAW is clearly worse than CSZ on RankIC (-0.0247 pooled, all three months negative) and degrades every guardrail (turnover +17%, long-short and worst-day worse), so it is not a submission candidate.

CENTER closes most of the RAW gap but still loses to CSZ on RankIC (-0.0046 pooled, all three months negative, block-5 interval entirely below zero) and degrades the long-short and worst-day guardrails; it does not pass the pre-registered gate.

Neither candidate meets the pre-registered seed-29 trigger, so no additional training quota was spent; keeping V2-CSZ leaves the slot available for another direction instead of a candidate that already lost on identical keys and labels.
